purpose: Authoritative additive character-enrichment overlay for the six active Seekers of Ra. Preserves recorded campaign state while completing character-sheet context, expedition roles, equipment doctrine, and spell recommendations without silently converting the campaign to D&D 3.5.

authority.attached_spell_sheets: D&D 3.5 reference-only selection aids. Names/themes may inspire 2e-equivalent choices, but 3.5 mechanics, slots, DCs, ranges, domains and class progressions never become executable unless separately bound to verified 2e authority.
authority.player_control_boundary: Snogard remains player-controlled; enrichment never chooses his in-play actions or spends resources.

completion_model.stop_rule: Do not manufacture changes. A pass may record VERIFIED_NO_CHANGE when the existing record is already sufficient.

characters.party_role: Commander; divine caster; Sha'ir; healer; battlefield controller; magical investigator

enrichment_passes.core_record_integrity: KEEP recorded HP 64, AC 3, THAC0 14 and saves as campaign authority; multiclass levels remain tracked separately.
enrichment_passes.class_and_racial_abilities: KEEP Cleric 10 and verified Sha'ir features including Gen retrieval, Recognize Genie Work, Call Upon the Jann, Elemental Protection and Call a Genie; Desert Sage mechanics remain source-bound where unverified.
enrichment_passes.skills_and_proficiencies: KEEP Desert Survival, Ancient History, Religion, Spellcraft, Astrology and Elemental Lore. Recommended sheet annotation: explicitly identify Ancient Languages/Hieroglyph interpretation as party-supported rather than silently granting a new proficiency unless already recorded elsewhere.
enrichment_passes.weapons_armor_combat_loadout: KEEP Staff of Solar Authority as primary. Do not infer unrecorded staff powers. Preserve cloak/boots as recorded magic items.
enrichment_passes.exploration_and_desert_equipment: KEEP spell-component harness, desert survival kit and flash-protection lenses. Recommended mundane checklist: waterskin reserve, rope, chalk, mirror, oil/light fallback, mapping notes and sealed component pouches; only mark carried when inventory authority confirms them.
enrichment_passes.spellcasting_and_magic: COMPLETE: Cleric 10 uses verified priest progression 4/4/3/3/2 plus current prepared state; Sha'ir 9 retains Gen-fetch access through wizard spell level 5 and current six-spell cache. Utility doctrine below supplements selection without replacing current state.
enrichment_passes.personality_and_roleplay: Strategic spiritual guide whose curiosity about ancient magic can pull against expedition caution. Delegates to specialists and treats divine order and elemental reality as complementary.
enrichment_passes.campaign_and_tomb_utility: Primary magical answer to healing, magical wards, elemental hazards, curses/hostile magic, stone obstacles and emergency battlefield control.
enrichment_passes.weaknesses_and_constraints: Arcane curiosity; source-bound custom mechanics; Gen retrieval time/risk; component dependence; player-control boundary forbids automatic spell choice or spending.
enrichment_passes.final_sheet_audit: READY with explicit separation of Cleric slots, Sha'ir fetched cache, verified class features, source-bound custom abilities, components, familiar/companions and current resources.

spell_profile.note: Candidates are verified AD&D 2e entries from the packaged canonical spell database; deity/sphere and current-preparation legality still apply at preparation time.

enrichment_passes.class_and_racial_abilities: KEEP Lay on Hands, Detect Evil, Aura of Protection and Turn Undead. Solar Cleave remains source-bound custom execution.
enrichment_passes.skills_and_proficiencies: KEEP Scimitar, Dagger, Shield, camel riding, Desert Survival, Religion, Etiquette and Endurance. Recommended nonweapon emphasis: leadership/watch discipline is narrative unless a recorded proficiency exists.
enrichment_passes.weapons_armor_combat_loadout: Primary Malik +3 scimitar and shield; lance from mount; short composite bow/throwing spears for range; backup scimitar and ceremonial dagger retained.
enrichment_passes.exploration_and_desert_equipment: Keep desert-adapted armor/shield, survival kit and flash lenses. Add no new carried gear without Inventory confirmation.
enrichment_passes.spellcasting_and_magic: Paladin 9 is now flagged SPELL_CAPACITY_REQUIRES_2E_TABLE_BINDING. Do not leave his sheet implying permanently no spells. Populate a recommended first prepared choice only after exact 2e Paladin-9 slot progression is bound.
enrichment_passes.personality_and_roleplay: Solemn, devout, quietly compassionate, brave to the point of dangerous overcommitment.
enrichment_passes.campaign_and_tomb_utility: Front-line protection, undead pressure, anti-evil presence, door/line holding and emergency healing.
enrichment_passes.weaknesses_and_constraints: Reckless courage; custom Desert Paladin/Solar Cleave text remains unbound; exact spell slots not guessed from 3.5.

spell_profile.runtime_policy: NO SLOT SPEND UNTIL 2E PALADIN-9 PROGRESSION IS VERIFIED.

enrichment_passes.final_sheet_audit: READY except exact ranger spell progression/spheres; retain explicit source gap instead of silently denying class spellcasting.

spell_profile.runtime_policy: NO SLOT SPEND UNTIL 2E RANGER-8 PROGRESSION AND SPHERES ARE VERIFIED.

Excellent tomb/trap coverage from Cyrra plus Ery scholarship

recommendations: Bind verified 2e class spell-progression tables for Az, Dak and Ery next; then promote their prepared/known spell state without changing class identity.
Use attached 3.5 sheets only to rank useful spell themes; always map chosen names to 2e equivalents before runtime activation.
Keep Cyrra and Bar noncasters unless a verified AD&D source or explicit campaign rule establishes otherwise.
Do not add free magic items or replenish consumables during sheet enrichment.
Expose party role, finite expedition resources and source-bound mechanics clearly in the character-sheet UI.
